## 1. `<DataState>` wrapper component

Path: `components/shared/DataState.tsx`

Props:
```ts
{
  data: T | T[] | null | undefined
  isLoading?: boolean
  isError?: boolean
  error?: Error | null
  isEmpty?: boolean  // optional — inferred from data if array
  children: (data: T | T[]) => ReactNode
  loading?: ReactNode  // default: inherits nearest <Skeleton/> or spinner
  empty?: ReactNode    // default: <EmptyState title="Nothing here yet"/>
  error?: ReactNode    // default: <PageError/> (inline variant)
}
```

State resolution order: error → loading → empty → children(data).

## 2. `<EmptyState>` variant audit + enrichment

Current `components/shared/EmptyState.tsx` exists. Spec additional variants:
- **first-time** — friendly onboarding tone, prominent primary CTA, illustration allowed
- **no-results** — filter-empty context, "Clear filters" CTA, secondary "View all"
- **error** — wraps PageError for data-load failures
- **coming-soon** — feature not yet available (Pro plan etc.), upgrade CTA
- **permission** — "You don't have access" — request-access flow

Each variant: icon, title, description, CTA row, max-width 480px, center-aligned.

## 3. Empty state copy sheet (Quill will write)

List the 20+ pages that need polished empty states per the plan:
- Artists, Guest Artists, Locations, Commission rules
- Payroll runs, Consent templates, Reports tabs (6 tabs)
- Marketing campaigns, Ink registry, Team invites, Waitlist
- AI Design gallery
- Client tabs (photos/files/notes/comms/financial)

For each, specify: icon (lucide name), variant, title, description placeholder, primary CTA label.

## 4. Route error boundaries

Spec `error.tsx` for:
- `app/error.tsx` (global) — full-page PageError
- `app/(app)/error.tsx` — replace console.error with logger
- `app/admin/error.tsx` — replace console.error with logger
- `app/(auth)/error.tsx` — new
- `app/book/error.tsx` — new (customer-facing — friendlier copy)
- `app/consent/error.tsx` — new
- `app/invite/[token]/error.tsx` — already exists? verify
- `app/ai-design/shared/error.tsx` — new

Each uses `<PageError error={error} reset={reset} variant="..."/>`.

## 5. 404 page

Path: `app/not-found.tsx`
- Branded illustration (use lucide Compass or SearchX at 64px with primary color glow)
- Heading: "We can't find that page"
- Body: "It might have moved, or the link might be broken."
- Search input (triggers Cmd+K palette)
- 3 most-visited links row: Dashboard, Clients, Appointments
- "Return home" primary CTA

Also spec `app/(app)/not-found.tsx` if different behavior needed (authenticated 404 vs public 404).

## 6. Success feedback system

Two layers:
1. **Toast** — Sonner, already in tree. Spec consistent usage: success uses emerald, error uses destructive, info uses muted.
2. **Inline "Saved · 2s ago"** — for save-on-blur fields (per Sprint 11 Settings polish). Component: `<SaveIndicator lastSavedAt?: Date/>`.

## 7. Loading state "stuck prevention"

If loading > 3s, show additional helper text: "Still loading — check your connection?" beneath skeleton. 10s: show "This is taking longer than expected" with a Retry link.

Implement via `useLoadingTimeout(isLoading)` hook that returns `{ showHint3s, showHint10s }`.

## 8. Destructive confirmations

Spec two patterns:
- **Dialog confirm** — default for delete/archive. Uses AlertDialog.
- **Type-name confirm** — for high-risk (delete client with history, delete studio). User types entity name to enable the destructive button.

Single component: `<ConfirmDestructive name, verb, onConfirm, ...>`.

## 9. Implementation plan for Koda

Group the 40+ page migrations into 4 batches by feature area:
- Batch 1: Clients + Appointments + Dashboard
- Batch 2: Artists + Team + Schedule
- Batch 3: Commissions + Payroll + Billing
- Batch 4: Reports + Settings + Admin + Marketing + Inventory + Consent + AI

For each page, identify:
- Line where `'No data'` or `data && (...)` lives
- Which `<EmptyState variant>` to use
- If it has loading.tsx (Sprint 2), which skeleton

## 10. Acceptance criteria

```bash
rg 'console\.(log|error|warn)' app components lib   # 0
rg "'No data'|No data yet" app components           # 0 (all must use EmptyState)
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
```

Plus: every route group has error.tsx. `app/not-found.tsx` exists. `<DataState>` used in ≥ 20 pages.

## 11. `/dev/design` States section

Add new "States" section (section 11) to the showcase:
- Loading state examples (spinner, skeleton, ghost)
- 5 EmptyState variants side-by-side
- Error state (inline)
- Success toast demo trigger button
- SaveIndicator demo (toggle dirty/clean)
- 404 preview (mini)
- ConfirmDestructive dialog demo

Write the spec. Make Koda's job mechanical — no design decisions.

1	# InkOS — 12-Sprint Production-Grade UI/UX Hardening Program
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS has 73 authenticated pages, 13 public pages, 5 admin pages, 31 shadcn primitives, 255 domain components, and 200+ design tokens. Functionally complete, visually inconsistent. The audit surfaced 11 weakness areas: dark mode untested, loading states minimal (only 3 skeletons across 80+ components), error boundaries violate logger contract, mobile calendar broken, empty states ~50% covered, heading weight inconsistent, focus indicators unverified, color contrast unchecked in dark, no page transitions, calendar + consent builder desktop-only, no centralized Logo component.
6	
7	**Goal:** Ship a product that a customer would mistake for Linear, Stripe, or Attio. Every pixel intentional. Every state handled. Every breakpoint graceful. Every interaction < 200ms perceived. Zero console errors in production.
8	
9	**Execution model:** 12 sprints, each 6-10 autonomous hours. Total program: **95-115 hours** of agent work. Runnable in long blocks (5-10 hours per session) with agent coordination and explicit quality gates.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Competitive Benchmarks (the bar we're clearing)
14	
15	| Pattern | Primary benchmark | Secondary |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| Dashboard + KPI cards | **Linear** home, **Stripe** dashboard | Vercel, Cron |
18	| Calendar | **Cal.com**, **Fantastical** | Google Calendar |
19	| CRM / client profiles | **Attio**, **HubSpot** | Notion databases |
20	| Data tables + filters | **Linear** issues, **Attio** lists | Airtable |
21	| Command palette | **Raycast**, **Linear** cmd+k | Superhuman |
22	| Settings | **Stripe**, **Vercel** | Notion settings |
23	| Empty + loading states | **Linear**, **Height** | Notion |
24	| Motion / transitions | **Linear**, **Arc Browser** | Superhuman |
25	| Public booking (conversion) | **Cal.com** booking, **Calendly** | Stripe Checkout |
26	| Mobile treatment | **Stripe Dashboard mobile**, **Linear mobile** | Cron mobile |
27	
28	Rule: any pattern weaker than these three references gets redesigned.
29	
30	---
31	
32	## Agent Coordination Model
33	
34	Every sprint follows the **8-agent assembly line**:
35	
36	```
37	1. Nova     — 30-min competitor pass on the target area (screenshots, note patterns)
38	2. Vega     — Produce design spec (tokens, layouts, states, variants, motion)
39	3. Pixel    — For any public-facing page touched this sprint
40	4. Koda     — Build the spec (no design decisions — Vega's spec is law)
41	5. Dato     — Any schema/index/RLS needed for the feature
42	6. Luna     — Visual regression tests (Playwright) + component snapshot tests
43	7. Sage     — Code review gate (a11y, perf, types, security, design compliance)
44	8. Mira     — Capture lessons after each sprint → pattern library
45	```
46	
47	Rex orchestrates; Cadence watches agent performance; Witness classifies every run.
48	
49	**Quality gates** (every sprint must pass all):
50	- `pnpm typecheck` — 0 errors
51	- `pnpm lint --max-warnings=0` — 0 warnings
52	- Playwright visual regression — 0 unexplained diffs in light AND dark
53	- Lighthouse on every touched route — ≥ 90
54	- Axe a11y — 0 serious/critical violations
55	- Bundle size delta — ≤ +5% per sprint
56	- Sage approval — written ship/block verdict
57	
58	Any gate fails → sprint doesn't close → fixes continue until green.
59	
60	---
61	
62	## How to Run Continuously (5-10 hour sessions)
63	
64	**Session pattern:**
65	```
66	Hour 0–1   Nova competitor pass + Vega design spec (parallel)
67	Hour 1–5   Koda implementation (batched, parallel per page)
68	Hour 5–6   Dato + Luna (schema if needed, tests)
69	Hour 6–7   Sage review → fixes
70	Hour 7–8   Visual regression + Lighthouse + a11y gates
71	Hour 8–9   Mira extracts lessons, commits pushed per logical group
72	Hour 9–10  Verification on live Railway deploy
73	```
74	
75	Each sprint commits in 4-8 logical chunks. PR-sized commits, not one giant push. Rollback-safe.
76	
77	---
78	
79	## The 12 Sprints
80	
81	### PHASE A — FOUNDATION (Sprints 1–4)
82	*Lock the design DNA before touching feature pages. Everything downstream inherits from here.*
83	
84	---
85	
86	### Sprint 1 — Design System Foundation (8h)
87	
88	**Theme:** One source of truth for every visual decision.
89

91	1. **Token audit + dedupe.** `app/globals.css` has 200+ tokens — audit, group semantically, remove redundant ones. Produce `~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-design-tokens.md`.
92	2. **Typography system.** Enforce scale via `<Typography>` component:
93	   - `display` (36/40 bold) / `h1` (28/32 bold) / `h2` (20/24 semibold) / `h3` (16/24 semibold) / `body` (14/20) / `caption` (12/16) / `micro` (10/14 uppercase tracking-wide)
94	   - Kill inconsistent `font-bold` vs `font-semibold` on h1/h2 (50+ instances found)
95	3. **Spacing rhythm.** Standardize on 4/8/12/16/20/24/32/48/64. Lint rule rejects raw `margin: 13px`.
96	4. **Icon size scale.** xs=12 / sm=14 / md=16 / lg=20 / xl=24 / 2xl=32. Every icon uses scale.
97	5. **Shadow + radius scale.** Shadows: `soft`, `card`, `card-hover`, `soft-md`, `lift`, `overlay`. Radii: `sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/full`.

Key findings from the audit that shaped the spec:

**Audit corrections vs sprint plan brief:**

- The artists page was the canonical example of the ad-hoc triad pattern (explicit loading/error/empty triads). That pattern repeats across 40+ pages — `DataState` eliminates all of it.
- No `components/skeletons/` directory exists — Sprint 2 skeletons appear to be inline. Koda must audit this before batch migrations begin.
- `app/error.tsx` (global root) does not exist and must be created.

**Key design decisions:**
- `DataState` uses a generic `children: (data: NonNullable<T>) => ReactNode` — the type narrows automatically so Koda can't accidentally pass null to the success render.
- Loading timeout hints only display when no custom `loadingSlot` is provided — showing hints over a skeleton is visually incoherent.
- `EmptyState` `first-time` variant gets a subtle `bg-primary/[0.02]` container wash to differentiate from generic empty — same technique Linear uses on new workspace onboarding.
- `ConfirmDestructive` uses `Dialog` not `AlertDialog` because the input field requires two-way interaction; `AlertDialog` is for single-confirm only.
- `SaveIndicator` auto-hides after 5 seconds via `useEffect` cleanup — prevents stale "Saved · 47 minutes ago" text.
